transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
Hi doctor. I've been struggling a lot lately with paying attention and staying focused. I keep making really careless mistakes on things because I just can't seem to focus on the details.
Have you struggled with these focus and attention issues since you were a child, or is this something that started more recently?
I've actually struggled with these focus issues since I was a kid, definitely before I turned 12. However, it has become a really consistent and noticeable struggle for the past nine months.
Along with these focus issues, do you often find yourself feeling physically restless, fidgeting a lot, or acting impulsively?
No, I don't really experience physical restlessness, fidgeting, or impulsivity. My difficulties are pretty much limited to the focus and attention issues I mentioned.
Over these past nine months, have you also been experiencing persistent, excessive worry about everyday things that feels difficult to control?
No, I don't really experience persistent or uncontrollable worry about everyday things. My struggles are pretty much just related to my focus and attention.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were ['Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)', 'Generalized Anxiety Disorder', 'Major Depressive Disorder']. Based on the conversation, Generalized Anxiety Disorder is now ruled out because the patient denies persistent, uncontrollable worry. Major Depressive Disorder is also unlikely as the patient states their struggles are strictly limited to focus and attention issues, which have been present since childhood (before age 12). Since they also deny hyperactivity and impulsivity, the diagnosis is narrowed down to Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation).
